## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Lotte Zweig an Hannah Altmann [18. Juli 1940], SZ-AAL/B1.32
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.32
- Datum: 18.7.1940
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 5 Scans

pages.transcription:
The WYNDHAM
42 WEST 58TH STREET
NEW YORK
18.7.40

Dear Hanna!
I send this letter
by ordinary mail as I am not
sure whether there is a regular
connection with the clipper,
but I hope that you got all
our letters so far, some by air
and some by boat. We have
not yet had any news from you
besides the 2 cables but I very
much hope that you have written
us to Newyork. We have again
postponed our departure for
Brazil until the 9th August as
pages.notes: Briefkopf des Wyndham Hotels, handschriftlicher Text in violetter Tinte.

pages.transcription:
we are expecting first the various
replies from South America. We
shall probably leave Newyork
soon as there are too many
people here who want to see
Stefan, but we have not yet
decided, and in any case you
can always write us via the
Vikingpress who will also for-
ward by airmail any letter
which should arrive after our
departure to Brazil.
I have so far not yet
found a permanent home for
Eva. I am promised addresses
of good and reasonable boarding
schools, Anita Cahn who lives

in a suburb of Newyork would
be willing to take her for some
time and this would not be a
bad solution for the beginning.
That committee as the head of
which Stephen Wise sent you the
affidavit for Eva, will of course
place her somewhere, but as he
left ~~Newyork~~ immediately after we saw
him I had no chance to ask
further information. As soon as I
hear from you about the
prospects of Eva's coming I
shall try to get in touch with
the committee and see myself
what they propose. In the mean-
time I look round privately.
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Text in violetter Tinte. Das Wort 'Newyork' wurde durchgestrichen.

pages.transcription:
If it is possible I would like
very much to have one or two
photos of Eva. It may help in
placing her if people want to
fetch her from the boat - Anita
and Rose would do it if I should
have left - and finally I would
like to have a photo myself.
After all I have not renounced
my guardianship and do not in-
tend to do so. Do you know that
Harriet plans to come over and
that Carmel and Elsie want to
send their children, too? - I
am anxiously waiting for news
from you all, and the more
you write, the better. Try the
clipper-way too, it would make
such a difference, and as I said
before, letters which arrive here after
our departure from USA will be forwarded

Of course kindest regards to the whole family, Mr Miller
and William and the Levinthals.

Do write and tell the others to write,
Lotte
Yours affectionate
to South Am. by air. Do
and keep well.
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Text in violetter Tinte. Der Text am linken Rand und am rechten Rand wurde nachträglich hinzugefügt.
Farbskala und Grauskala für Archivierung. Der Textausschnitt in der Mitte ist eine Wiederholung des unteren Teils von Seite 4.

result.confidence_notes: Der Text ist sehr gut lesbar, die Handschrift ist klar. Die Anordnung der Randnotizen auf Seite 4 wurde logisch in den Textfluss integriert.
